hints.title: Two Valid Targets
hints.text: The final sorted state can either have the empty space 0 at index 0, or at index n - 1.

hints.title: Permutation Decomposition
hints.text: Model the target configuration as a permutation of positions. Dissect the permutation into disjoint cycles.

hints.title: Cycles with Zero
hints.text: A cycle containing the empty space 0 requires cycle_length - 1 swaps. A cycle without 0 requires cycle_length + 1 swaps to bring 0 into the cycle and back.

hints.title: Cycle Decomposition Implementation

complexity.notes: Each element belongs to exactly one permutation cycle in each target orientation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search over full permutation space explodes factorially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for visited indicators and positional lookup tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models the operations as permutation cycle decomposition and distinguishes cycles with or without the empty zero space.
